Job Description:
About the Job:
LaunchDarkly is seeking an Executive Assistant to partner closely with our Chief Revenue Officer and support the broader global Revenue organization as it scales.
This role will help the CRO stay focused on the highest-priority work by managing their calendar, travel, meetings, and competing priorities. The right person will anticipate needs, resolve scheduling conflicts, and make thoughtful decisions about what requires the CRO’s attention.
The Revenue organization spans Sales, Customer Success, pre- and post-sales, Partnerships, and international markets. As the organization grows, the EA may also provide administrative support to other senior Revenue leaders. The right person will be comfortable working across time zones, navigating senior stakeholders, handling confidential information, and learning the CRO’s priorities and working style.
LaunchDarkly is a rapidly growing software company with a strong mission and vision carried out by a talented and diverse team of employees. Our goal is to help teams build better software, faster. Software powers the world and LaunchDarkly empowers all teams to deliver and control their software.
Responsibilities:

- Manage the CRO’s calendar, priorities, meeting flow, and time allocation across a globally distributed organization.

- Triage scheduling requests and prepare the CRO for key meetings by confirming logistics, participants, and materials; recommend what should be delegated, deferred, or declined.

- Manage domestic and international travel, bookings, logistics, expenses, approvals, and last-minute changes.

- Plan and coordinate Revenue leadership offsites, including quarterly gatherings, and other executive events; attend select events in person.

- Coordinate scheduling and logistics for the CRO’s participation in Revenue leadership meetings and other recurring forums in partnership with the Chief of Staff and Revenue Operations.

- Provide administrative support to the global Partnerships leader and, as the organization grows, other senior Revenue leaders.

- Coordinate meetings with customers, partners, executives, and other strategic stakeholders.

- Build strong relationships across Revenue, Finance, People, Legal, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams while maintaining systems that improve visibility and follow-through.

- Handle sensitive information with discretion and confidentiality and support administrative follow-through for select executive priorities and events.

Qualifications:

- Experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner, or comparable role supporting senior or C-level executives in a globally distributed organization.

- Experience working in a software or technology company; high-growth or B2B SaaS experience is a plus.

- Experience managing executive calendars, travel, expenses, complex scheduling, and meeting or event logistics.

- Demonstrated ability to anticipate problems, protect executive focus, and make sound decisions about competing priorities.

- Strong organization, attention to detail, follow-through, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to learn an executive’s working style and business priorities, manage up, and support multiple senior leaders as needs evolve.

- Sound judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, and comfort handling confidential information.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and related collaboration tools.

- AI fluency and curiosity, with the ability to use emerging tools thoughtfully to improve productivity, organization, and administrative workflows while protecting confidential information.

- Experience supporting a CRO, President, CEO, or other externally facing executive is a plus.

Job Description:
We are hiring for a Senior Executive Assistant & Team Coordinator to join our team within the Meliore Foundation.

This role reports to the Operations and Project Manager and directly supports our Barcelona-based Director, who oversees two ambitious and distinct programmes: The Better Information Project (TBIP) and Future of Tech Institute (FOTI).About the Programme: 

TBIP’s mission is to create a revitalised and resilient information ecosystem in Europe. We are working to tackle the structural power of Big Tech and enable the regulatory and enforcement conditions for policymakers, civil society, and entrepreneurs to develop and scale alternatives to the prevailing model. FOTI is a think tank dedicated to building a prosperous and fair European future that harnesses the power of technology.About the Role

The Senior Executive Assistant & Team Coordinator is a pivotal role providing high-level, proactive support to our Executive Director while acting as a key coordination point across TBIP and FOTI.

Working closely with the Executive Director and Operations & Project Manager, you will take ownership of complex diary and inbox management, coordinate stakeholder and funder engagement, and support effective communication and collaboration across both teams.This is a role for someone who thrives on anticipating needs, exercising sound judgement and navigating competing priorities. You will be a trusted partner to the Executive Director, helping to protect their time, maintain visibility of team activities and ensure that important decisions and commitments are followed through.

You'll be part of a small, highly collaborative and ambitious team working across Europe.

How you'll contribute

Senior Executive Assistance & Director Support (70%)

- Take full ownership of the Executive Director's complex diary, exercising independent judgement to prioritise competing demands, anticipate needs and protect time for strategic priorities.

- Proactively manage the Executive Director's inbox, identifying priorities, drafting correspondence, monitoring follow-ups and ensuring timely responses to key stakeholders.

- Support the Executive Director's engagement with key stakeholders, strategic partners and funders, proactively coordinating outreach, preparing briefing materials and ensuring timely follow-up on meetings and commitments.

- Coordinate complex meetings across multiple time zones, ensuring agendas, briefing materials and pre-reads are prepared and that the Executive Director is fully briefed.

- Plan and manage international travel and logistics, including detailed itineraries, bookings and preparation for external meetings, speaking engagements and convenings.

- Exercise discretion and sound judgement in managing confidential information, sensitive correspondence and competing requests for the Executive Director's attention.

- Coordinate expenses and administrative approvals, including contracts, leave and other requests requiring the Executive Director's review or sign-off.

Team Coordination & Liaison (30%)

- Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive Director and TBIP and FOTI teams, facilitating effective communication, information sharing and follow-through on key priorities.

- Support the Executive Director in maintaining oversight of team activities and commitments, proactively gathering updates, tracking actions and deadlines, and flagging potential bottlenecks or matters requiring attention.

- Support effective team collaboration and knowledge sharing, maintaining shared resources and documentation, and identifying practical improvements to coordination and ways of working.

- Coordinate team meetings, retreats, workshops and internal events, helping to foster a connected and collaborative culture across both programmes.

Our ideal candidate has

- Extensive experience in a senior Executive Assistant or similar role, supporting executive-level leadership in a complex, fast-paced or international organisation.

- Exceptional organisational, planning and prioritisation skills, with a proven ability to manage competing demands, anticipate needs and exercise independent judgement.

- A proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with the confidence to take initiative, make decisions and ensure effective follow-through.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and engage professionally with senior stakeholders, funders and colleagues.

- Experience managing complex executive diaries, inboxes, international travel and high-level meetings across multiple time zones.

- Strong coordination skills, with the ability to maintain visibility of multiple priorities, track commitments and facilitate effective communication across teams.

- A high degree of discretion, professionalism and sound judgement when handling sensitive information and confidential matters.

- Strong technical proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office and digital collaboration or project management tools.

- A collaborative, adaptable and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to thrive in a distributed, fast-moving team.

- A genuine interest in our mission and the wider conversations around technology, regulation and democratic resilience in Europe.

- Recognize stalled conversations, overdue follow-ups, and opportunities that require renewed attention.

- Support re-engagement campaigns and outreach strategies intended to generate meetings, referrals, and future business opportunities.

2. Meeting Coordination & Relationship Management

- Schedule business development calls, meetings, and in-person lunches between leadership and high-priority contacts.

- Coordinate calendars and ensure promising conversations translate into defined next steps.

- Draft and send professional outreach emails that reflect the firm's voice, positioning, and previous relationship with the recipient.

- Monitor relevant inbound communications and organize or route client inquiries, drawings, and project requests.

- Keep leadership informed of meaningful responses, potential opportunities, objections, and relationship developments.

- Ensure that important conversations and commitments are followed through rather than left undocumented.

3. Marketing Support & Materials Maintenance

- Maintain organized marketing materials and project reference documents used for business development and relationship-building.

- Help manage the firm's LinkedIn presence by reviewing connection requests, monitoring messages, and identifying relevant industry contacts.

- Research target firms, industry opportunities, and potential partnerships that could expand the business development pipeline.

- Coordinate updates to company materials, including project lists, award announcements, and website content, when applicable.

- Manage business development meetings, calls, and follow-up calendars through Microsoft Outlook.

- Organize proposal files, project documents, and communication records so leadership can retrieve the correct information when needed.

- Track proposal and client-request deadlines, missing documents, pending actions, and required follow-ups.

- Monitor assigned project coordination items by tracking deadlines, coordinating with internal team members and clients, and confirming that required documents, drawings, and deliverables are received and organized.

- Maintain documentation and process trackers for outreach, marketing activities, and internal priorities.

- 
Pacific Time Availability: Full-time availability for eight hours per day, Monday through Friday, during Pacific Time business hours.

- 
Professional English Communication: Fluent, confident, and professional spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate credibly with business owners, executives, architects, contractors, and other professional stakeholders.

- 
B2B Business Development Experience: Proven professional-level experience in business development, sales support, client relationship management, account management, lead generation, or comparable client-facing work.

Outbound Calling Confidence: Demonstrated ability to initiate outbound phone calls, engage professional contacts, and maintain conversations without depending exclusively on email or written communication.

Professional or Technical Services Exposure: Experience representing or supporting a professional or technical service to a B2B audience.

Relationship Management: Experience managing client relationships, prospect follow-ups, outreach campaigns, or account management activities.

Pipeline & Follow-Up Management: Experience using a CRM, outreach tracker, or structured follow-up system to manage contact status, next actions, and follow-up schedules.

- 
Research & Prospecting: Ability to identify relevant target companies, decision-makers, and business opportunities through online research and professional networking platforms.

- 
Independent Execution: Ability to prioritize activities, recognize overdue follow-ups, manage competing responsibilities, and take ownership of results without daily step-by-step supervision.

- 
Organization & Documentation: Consistent and accurate documentation of interactions, relationship context, opportunities, and pending actions.

- 
Microsoft Office Proficiency: Working proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel.

Experience in architecture, engineering, construction, real estate development, design firms, building products, or similar professional services is strongly preferred.

- Business development or account management in professional services, architecture, engineering, construction, real estate development, design firms, or building product suppliers.

- Experience with architect-adjacent markets, custom manufacturers, luxury residential service providers, or similar B2B industries.

- Experience using LinkedIn for prospect research, professional networking, and relationship development.

- Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI-assisted productivity tools.

Tools & Systems

RingCentral: Outbound calling and phone-system access.

- 
Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Overview
POSITION SUMMARY: 
Under the general supervision of the Operations Manager, the Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for the coordination of administrative processing of disability determinations for all in and out of state contracts. This position is responsible for making strategic decisions on case assignment and for keeping cases on timeline. The Lead Disability Assistant is responsible for work flow management and training of Disability Assistants as well as performing those front line functions when necessary to maintain unit production standards. This position is the primary hub for all incoming/outgoing correspondence, disability supplements, and is the primary interface with clients, agencies, and DES staff regarding incoming and outgoing medical information, mail, transportation and records. Decisions made in this area directly impact the timeline for the disability review process, the workload of review staff, and the determination of benefits for all in and out of state agency applicants. The Lead Disability Assistant is a primary customer service interface for DES' SPMP with clients and external agencies.
Responsibilities
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

- Manage unit work flow, assuring the proper numbers of Disability Assistants are assigned to each task on a daily basis.

- Train new and existing Disability Assistants in work functions and job duties.

- Monitor customer service phone queues for adequate coverage and provide call escalation response for front line staff.

- Monitor unit key performance indicators.

- Act as unit Disability Liaison for agency partner inquiries and issues.

- Track priority case requests and ensure prompt completion of work on such cases.

- Initial review of all disability supplements for accuracy, completeness, and alerting SPMP of priority cases and of important clinical information contained in cases.

- Make complex decisions regarding privacy matters associated with the client’s case, including determination of who DES may exchange information with regarding the client’s case, what information may be mailed, and what is required, by HIPAA, to allow conversations to take place. These decisions are conveyed to SPMP through detailed case notes and individual consultation.

- Determine if requests for information are legally complete, communicate with agencies about cases that do not meet HIPAA requirements for protected healthcare information and consult with SPMP about decisions regarding whether to return to cases to the agencies or clients for further development.

- Telephone contact with clinical treating sources to assure timely receipt of clinical information at the request and direction of SPMP.

- Review information in external databases such as the Massachusetts Medicaid Information System and MassHealth MA21databases in order to identify cases that SPMP could complete quickly.

- Coordinate transportation of clients to consultative examinations and provide feedback to SPMP on unusual circumstances that would impact the review process.

- Make decisions for rescheduling of clients’ clinical evaluations, based upon agency guidelines and provides input and feedback to SPMP. Explain complex state and federal regulations to clients, agencies and medical providers, answer disability process questions as they arise.

- Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- 2-Year College Degree in business or a related field

- 5-7 years of relevant office experience

- Demonstrated knowledge of medical terminology or willingness to take a course in Medical Terminology

- Knowledge of HIPAA laws and regulations especially as it refers to the confidentiality of PHI

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

- Demonstrated ability to monitor and generate reports

- Requires organizational and excellent interpersonal skills, oral and written communication skills necessary to interact with all levels of personnel.

Additional Information
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience in a medical setting

- Knowledge of DEScovery database

- Experience working as a member of an inbound/outbound call center

- Experience training staff on complex tasks

- Ability to create power point demonstrations for the purpose of training staff

- Thorough understanding of DES’s processes and procedures pertaining to all in and out of state contracts

- Ability to create processes and procedures for new programs as need arises.

Job Description:
About FreedUp

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.
About the role
We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
Location: Remote, LATAM
Job Type: Full-time
What you'll do
1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

- Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

- Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

- After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

- Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

2. Coordinate the sales team

- Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

- Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

- Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

- Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

- Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

4. Manage his calendar and reminders

- Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

- Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

- Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

5. Book travel

- Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

- Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

- Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

6. Handle personal and admin tasks

- Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

- Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

- Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

- Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

Please note: this role does not include client calls or onboarding. He handles all client conversations himself. Beyond these tasks, he wants you to audit his systems, spot the low-hanging fruit and tell him what else you can take off his plate.
Our hiring process

- Apply online

- Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter

- Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

- Complete a work evaluation

- Final interview with the client

Requirements
Must-haves

- At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Coordinator or in a similar support role.

- A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

- Disciplined and professional.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable handling both business and personal tasks.

- High discretion with client, financial and payroll information.

- Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

Nice-to-haves

- A good sense of humor and a likable personality.

- Experience with Notion as a CRM.

- Comfort using AI tools, especially Claude.

- Sales operations or high-ticket sales support experience.

- Experience with GoHighLevel.

Tools & Communication: Notion, Claude, Outlook, Dropbox, Zoom, Calendly, DocuSign, GoHighLevel, and Kayak and airline apps. Communication is mainly by text, with phone calls when needed (no Slack).

- Compensation in USD

- Health insurance allowance

- PTO + Holidays

- Training and ongoing support from the FreedUp team

Job Title: Executive Support Specialist - California Insurance Experience Required
Job Description:
The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.
About RemotePro.ph
We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.
To apply, please visit us at: 
Summary
This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.
Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For
The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

- They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution 

- They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it 

- They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality 

- They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting 

- They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas 

- They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here
People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.
We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

- You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track 

- You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response 

- You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice 

- You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation 

- Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule 

- You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans 

- You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start 

- Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy 

There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.
Responsibilities
You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.
That looks like:

- Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role

- Managing inbound communication across email and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention

- Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem

- Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination

- Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing

- Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current

- Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks

- Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed

Requirements

- At least 1 year of recent, hands-on experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines — handling renewals, quoting, and account servicing; this is the non-negotiable requirement for this role

- Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard

- Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role

- Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

- Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)

- Strong written English — emails are clear and professional before they're sent

- High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk

- Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips

- Self-directed once you're up to speed — asks the right questions early, works independently after

Nice to Have

- Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent) 

- Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment 

- Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or Monday.com) 

- Basic bookkeeping or invoice processing experience (QuickBooks or Xero) 

- Experience with market research and competitor analysis

How We Work
We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it.
There’s real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won’t be right on the first try. That’s how we find the right path. We don’t punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.
We’re a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That’s part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.
Benefits
Permanent Work-from-Home Setup
Competitive Salary
HMO Coverage
Mental Health Programs
Maternity Assistance through HMO (Female employees)
Paid Vacation Leave
Technology Allowance
Internet Allowance
Weekly Payouts
Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities

- Ability to independently handle routine civil litigation work, proactively resolve missing information, and appropriately escalate substantive legal questions to attorneys.

- Experience using MerusCase or comparable litigation case management software; MerusCase experience is strongly preferred.

- Paralegal certification or formal legal education.

- Previous experience working remotely with U.S. attorneys or litigation teams.

- Broader experience supporting motions and other pretrial litigation work.

Mosaic Conseil operates as a small, remote workshop dedicated to rebuilding one business artifact at a time. Whether it is a three year plan, a pricing grid, or a diligence file, we take things apart on the bench and put them back together against the evidence of the invoice ledger. The process is personal and focused. We do not work on standing retainers and we do not produce slide decks. Instead, we return the same artifact you sent, redrawn by hand and supported by a written argument. Our work is handled on paper and backed by a telephone number that answers for ninety days. We keep the workshop small on purpose to ensure that the people who do the work also answer their own phones. There are no meetings we did not schedule and no corporate theater. We focus on four specific rooms: financial services, industrial networks, growing software companies, and healthcare systems.
 
About Mosaic Conseil
 We are a boutique consultancy that values intellectual honesty and the discipline of a small, focused team. By staying small and fully remote, we remain independent and focused on the evidence at the floor of the business. Our clients come to us when they need a business plan or a financial model rebuilt with extreme precision. We provide a workspace where the primary goal is getting the numbers and the logic right, rather than making things look good in a presentation. Every file that leaves our workshop carries two names on the cover: one person who builds and one who argues against what was built. This ensures that every assumption is tested before a file closes. This environment is built for thinkers who prefer a written argument over a status meeting.
 
What you would do
 As an AI Testing Assistant, your work focuses on the intersection of business logic and automated analysis. You will be responsible for testing the outputs of AI models used to process financial and industrial data. This is an entry level role where you support our consultants by stress testing the artifacts we build. Your day to day work involves: 
- Reviewing AI generated summaries and data extractions for accuracy against original source documents like ledgers or contracts.
 
- Running standardized tests on internal AI tools to identify where they fail to grasp complex financial logic or industrial constraints.
 
- Building simple test cases to verify that a pricing model or a business plan remains consistent when variables are changed.
 
- Documenting specific instances of model error or hallucination in a clear, written format.
 
- Assisting the challenger in our builder and challenger model by providing evidence of where an automated calculation may have deviated from the truth.
 
- Comparing different AI model outputs to see which one handles specific industry terminology from healthcare or industrial networks more reliably.
 
- Verifying that the data used for a specific business artifact has been correctly mapped by our automated scripts.

Helpful background
 We are looking for individuals who have a natural curiosity about how technology works and, more importantly, how it breaks. This role is accessible to those starting their career or looking for part time work while finishing their studies. Helpful traits and experiences include: 
- Basic familiarity with Large Language Models and an understanding of how to prompt them for technical tasks.
 
- Competence in using spreadsheets like Excel or Google Sheets to verify calculations.
 
- Strong writing skills and the ability to explain a technical error in plain English.
 
- A background in business, finance, or computer science is useful but we value the ability to follow a logical argument above a specific degree.
 
- Technical comfort with remote work tools and a disciplined approach to managing your own schedule.
 
- Experience with personal projects or academic work that involves data analysis or AI testing.
 
- An interest in the specific sectors we serve, particularly financial services and industrial networks.

How we work
 Our workshop is entirely remote, meaning you can work from wherever you are most productive. We do not have an office and we do not hold meetings unless they are strictly necessary for the work. We communicate primarily through written documents and internal notes. Our builder and challenger model means that your work as a tester is central to our reputation. You are not just a support person: you are an essential part of the verification process that allows us to stand behind every artifact we produce. We prioritize deep work and give our team the quiet they need to find the errors that others miss. There is no requirement for residency in a specific city or country, as we operate a global, decentralized bench.
 
What the role offers
 This is a part time, contract position that is fully remote. You will have the opportunity to learn how high level business artifacts are constructed and how AI can be reliably integrated into professional services. The work is intellectually demanding and avoids the typical overhead of corporate life. We provide a space where you can focus on technical competence and analytical rigor. The position is paid and the pay is attractive for the role and the market, reflecting the care and attention to detail we expect from our testers. You will work directly with experienced professionals who answer their own phones and audit their own work, offering a direct view into the mechanics of boutique consultancy.
 Precision in our workshop is not a goal but a requirement. We believe that a business artifact is only as good as the evidence that supports it, and as an AI Testing Assistant, you are the one who ensures that evidence is sound. By looking for the cracks in the model before the client sees the work, you help us maintain a standard of intellectual honesty that is rare in modern consulting. Our process is slow by design, allowing for the kind of thoroughness that a faster, larger firm cannot provide.
